manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Faceless Butcher must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Faceless Butcher for its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
